📚 Hard vocab word #97: LIMPID

limpid (adjective): clear; easy to understand (of water or writing)

✅ In a sentence: Her limpid prose made complex science easy to follow.
✅ Similar: clear, transparent, lucid
✅ Remember it: Describes water, eyes, or writing.
